blurb: Guests cruise aboard the M/V Gansett, a traditionally restored 50-ft lobster boat, on narrated tours of Newport Harbor and Narragansett Bay. Tours include morning, afternoon, and sunset cruises with complimentary drinks and cash bar options. Private charters and special event cruises are also available.
